Date of accident : 24.12.2020
 Date of filing of DAR/Petition : 25.09.2021
 Date of Decision : 08.01.2025
Mact No. 573/2021 Sushila Patra vs. Aman Awana Page 1 of 4
 Award

1. Detailed Accident Report was filed by police in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act in respect of fatal injuries sustained by Sh. Subasish Patra S/o Sh. Harish Chandra Patra on account of alleged rash and negligent driving of vehicle bearing Registration No. DL5CK 0027 (hereinafter called the offending vehicle) driven by Sh.Aman Awana (hereinafter called Sushila Patra (Dar) vs Aman Awana(639/20,Jaitpur) on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155615926/
1 the Respondent No.1), owned by Sh. Shiv Kumar Awana (hereinafter called the Respondent No.2) and insured with HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd. (hereinafter called the insurance company), which is being treated as Claim Petition in view of the provisions contained in such Act.
2. Matter has been settled between claimants and insurance company for a sum of Rs.32,00,000/-
(Rupees Thirty Two Lakhs only).

entities.text: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Statements of Ld. Counsel for claimants as well as Ld. counsel for insurance company have been recorded separately to this effect.

3. In view of above, the matter is disposed off passing an award for a sum of Rs.32,00,000/-
(Rupees Thirty Two only) in favour of claimants/petitioners, payable by insurance company of offending vehicle to the claimants/petitioners within one month from the receipt of copy of order,
failing which the amount shall be payable with interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of filing of claim petition till realization.

4. The award amount shall be deposited with State Bank of India, Saket Court Branch, New Delhi by way of RTGS/NEFT/IMPS in account of MACT FUND PARKING, A/c No. 00000042706870765,
IFS Code SBIN0014244 and MICR code 110002342 under intimation to the Nazir along with calculation of interest and to the Counsel for the petitioners.
MODE OF DISBURSEMENT OF THE AWARD AMOUNT TO THE CLAIMANTS AS PER THE PROVISIONS OF THE 'MODIFIED CLAIM TRIBUNAL AGREED PROCEDURE' (MCTAP).

5. This Tribunal is in receipt of the orders dated 07.12.2018 passed by the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in FAO no. 842/2003 titled as Rajesh Tyagi & Ors. Vs. Jaibir Singh & Ors whereby the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi has formulated MACAD (Motor Accident Claims Annunity Deposit Scheme)
which has been made effective from 01.01.2019.

entities.text: Rajesh Tyagi & Ors. Vs. Jaibir Singh & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: MACAD (Motor Accident Claims Annunity Deposit Scheme)

sentences.text: The said orders dated 07.12.2018 also mentions that 21 banks including State Bank of India is one of such banks which are to adhere to MACAD.
The State Bank of India, Saket Courts, Delhi is directed to disburse the amount in accordance with MACAD formulated by the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
6. Ld.
Counsel for claimants states that entire settlement amount may be released to claimant as claimant is suffering from financial constraints.
Apportionment:
7. In her statement claimant stated that apart from her, her husband is survived by his father and two children (son and daughter), while mother of deceased had pre-deceased him.
Now, the compensation is apportioned amongst the legal heirs of deceased in the following manner:
(I) Share of wife of the deceased:
Out of the compensation amount, wife of deceased is awarded Rs.19,00,000/- with interest as stated above of the compensation.
Out of such amount, Rs.15,00,000/- is kept in form of monthly FDRs of Rs.20,000/- each.
Sushila Patra (Dar) vs Aman Awana(639/20,Jaitpur) on 8 January, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155615926/
2

Remaining amount of Rs.4,00,000/-
be released to the wife of deceased in her bank account near her place of residence as per rule/
directions.
(II) Share of son of deceased:
Out of the compensation amount, son of deceased is awarded Rs.6,00,000/-.
Since son of deceased is minor, his share be kept in FDR till he attains the age of majority.
(III) Share of daughter of deceased:
Out of the compensation amount, daughter of deceased is awarded Rs.6,00,000/-.
Since she is minor, her share be kept in FDR till she attains the age of majority.
(IV) Share of father of deceased:
Out of the compensation amount, he father of deceased is awarded Rs.1,00,000/-, to be released to him.
8. Copy of this settlement award be given to the parties free of cost and a copy of award be also sent to DLSA, South East, Delhi as well as to the Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate concerned.
9. List for compliance on 10.02.2025.
